title: Mac root TermAl MCP mailbox and session-list reads abort while the CLI succeeds
outcome: Ordinary macOS root sessions can read their mailbox and list sessions through the injected TermAl MCP tools, or receive a concrete actionable error rather than an unexplained aborted result.
acceptance: A disposable macOS root reproducer exercises termal_read_mailbox and termal_list_sessions through the actual injected bridge and distinguishes provider cancellation, bridge failure and backend refusal from a successful equivalent CLI read.
Any confirmed in-scope bridge defect is fixed with behavioral coverage; mailbox reading and receipt acknowledgement retain their existing authority and FIFO semantics.
